name: Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited
summary: Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited provides engineering solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Manufacturing of Machinery & Equipment; and Industrial Projects. The company provides process plant equipment, including reactors, high pressure vessels, shell and tube heat exchangers, columns and towers, and high pressure boiler drums; boilers, such as solid and biomass fuels, bagasse and biomass, oil and gas fired, blast furnace gas fired, waste to energy, and heat recovery boilers, as well as auxiliaries comprising air pollution control equipment, bag filters, SCR/SNCR, flue gas desulphurization systems, and deaerators; and site construction and commissioning, operation and maintenance,…
